comments.why: Sketch about nonsense brand names on Amazon.
comments.text: "Bugfree". The problem with "ZenTao" is that it's too close to a game (Zendo), Buddhism, and New Age hippies. The problem with "Sanplex" is it reads like it came from an algorithm for permuting English sylables to produce things that sound almost like they might be brands if it's not your first language, like all the suspicious vendors on Amazon for the last few years: [VIDEO] The other problem with "Sanplex" is every fourth time I read it, my inner monologue vocalises "Spandex" instead.
